tools.name: visa_cost_estimate
tools.description: Estimate the Home Office fees for a UK visa or citizenship application: application fee per applicant, Immigration Health Surcharge for the length of leave (adult and child rates, Home Office part-year rounding), priority or super-priority service, and route extras such as the citizenship ceremony.
